spoken_summary: Adelita Grijalva says it is her second day in Washington D.C. and she has not yet been sworn into her position. She states that Speaker Johnson has "left the building" and she doesn't know when the swearing-in will occur. She argues that as long as she remains unsworn, "Southern Arizona does not have a voice" and her district lacks services. She urges viewers to contact Speaker Johnson and tell him she needs to be sworn in.
